summary.oneLiner: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.

hero.oneLiner: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Beauty, cosmetics and personal care ("BPC") company that brands, procures and distributes products under the "Recode" brand; featured on Shark Tank India and recognised through industry awards, which the deck says strengthens brand trust.
- Digital-first company with strong online presence via its own website, social media and marketplaces, combined with a physical retail footprint (omnichannel presence).

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: FY26 revenue mix: Online Sales 43.87% (72% direct website/app), FOFO Stores 24.50%, B2B 30.73%, COCO Stores 0.91%. 350+ SKUs across 5 categories: Eye, Face, Lip, Body, Accessories.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: n/a (B2C brand with no order book)

guidance.title: Guidance / outlook
guidance.body: Guiding for at least 50% revenue growth in FY27; expanding retail footprint (FOFO/COCO), modern trade, quick commerce, and Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027)

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Expansion into modern trade and quick commerce; potential international rollout; private label development for B2B; Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027) enabling regional scale

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EBITDA margin improved from 46.1% (FY25) to 106.3% (FY26) due to asset-light model, better marketing efficiency, and SKU mix optimization; gross margin improved from ~54% (FY25) to ~60% (FY26) based on revenue and COGS trends

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: IPO proceeds allocated to working capital, retail expansion (FOFO/COCO), modern trade/quick commerce penetration, and supply chain (Ludhiana warehouse); no dividends or buybacks mentioned

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Intense competition from established players (L'Oréal, Nykaa, Mamaearth); inflationary pressure on raw materials; reliance on digital marketing for CAC; execution risk in rapid retail expansion; regulatory changes in e-commerce or cosmetics labeling

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: 72% of online sales are direct via own app/website — rare for Indian DTC beauty brands, indicating strong brand loyalty and low platform dependency; 500+ masterclasses conducted build institutional credibility beyond retail
